title: Final Boss Of The First Loop
paragraphs: “Fufufufu… Evil blood? No, that’s not it. This is the power of the gods, the divine power bestowed upon us! Do you not understand our divine appearance?”
As I was distracted by the red-black pig, the New Pope spoke. That’s supposed to be divine? What’s wrong with your eyes?
“Divine? No matter how you look at it, it only seems evil…”
“Final boss… no, more like a mid-boss in appearance.”
“Right? At best, Motoyasu-san, wouldn’t you say this is like a first-playthrough final boss at most?”
What kind of comparison is that? These guys are nothing more than weaklings with an intimidating appearance.
“That’s because you are beings of darkness! That’s why you cannot properly recognize us, who are imbued with this holy power! That is the greatest proof of all!”
“Nano! Demonic beings can distort power and manipulate perception! That’s why, to them, it must look divine!”
I see. To them, maybe it appears like angel wings? Hah! Angels refer to the Filolials! These guys certainly don’t look anything like that.
“The castle soldiers were nothing more than sacrifices to pour power into summoning God… Yes, summoning the true God requires immense power, and thus, sacrifices are necessary.”
“Hey… I feel like he’s even harder to talk to than Takt…”
“His brain must be completely fried.”
“Let’s put him out of his misery quickly.”
While that conversation went on, I saw something like a mass of power suddenly surge and merge into the New Pope and Trash. Their auras flared up as they stepped forward.
“The Hero Summoning Ritual is still being performed by our followers. To save the world, painful sacrifices are necessary… Indeed, to let the greater life thrive, the lesser ones must be culled.”
“Only the followers of the true God will survive. Those with misguided faith must be sacrificed. To keep the great tree of the world alive, unnecessary branches must be cut.”
The New Pope and Trash’s body double seem to truly believe that what they are doing is righteous. So, in their logic, summoning the so-called true Four Holy Heroes actually requires human sacrifices?
“To let the greater life thrive, huh…? If that ‘greater life’ is actually a pest, then it’s nothing but a meaningless sacrifice.”
“Exactly. Before cutting unnecessary branches, you need to remove the rotten parts first, or the entire tree will wither and die.”
Ren and Itsuki dismiss the New Pope and Trash’s reasoning with exasperation.
“Hmph… Spout whatever nonsense you like. Our territory is already being covered by our dispersed followers. Yes… the ritual formation is expanding!”
“With each passing second, the citizens are uniting as one to supply the power needed to defeat you!”
“What!?”
Father directed his awareness toward the outside of the castle. I could sense some kind of magical flow.
“If what they just said is true, then the dangerous demon-summoning ritual is still ongoing, and as its range expands, it’s draining power from the citizens… is that what’s happening?”
“…It seems we don’t have much time. We must stop the ritual immediately!”
At the Queen’s words, we all nodded.
“Sakura-chan, Gaelion-chan, Wyndia-chan, locate the place where this ridiculous ritual is being conducted!”
“There’s no need.”
“Yeah, even I can tell where it is.”
“Indeed, it’s obvious.”
Oh? Before Father could even ask, Rival and the Filolials already seemed to know the source of the ritual.
“It’s over there. The spell is automatically activating using those guys as the medium.”
Rival pointed at the New Pope and his group as he spoke. It seems the Filolials share the same understanding.
“It looks like they’re using human bodies to conduct the ritual and gather power.”
“So, in other words, they themselves are functioning as a magic formula to amass energy…?”
“Nano! They’re probably even absorbing the power of the Earth within their domain, forcibly surpassing the limits of a human body!”
“Experience points involve containing the power of the Earth… right? So, they’re continuously supplying experience points to a body that has already reached its limit… is that what’s happening?”
“Nano!”
“I don’t really get it.”
I couldn’t quite grasp what Father and Rival were trying to say.
“Motoyasu-sama, in other words, they are continuously forcing their way past the level limit. And in that state, they are commanding and embodying demonic entities.”
Yuki-chan’s explanation made it click for me. As always, she’s incredibly smart.
“So basically, their level has far surpassed 100?”

They’ve resorted to an absolutely reckless method. Doing something like that would probably kill them instantly. Now that I look closely, I can see their veins bulging, and their muscles appear to be swelling unnaturally.
“You finally understand… In short, it looks like they’re forcefully creating a state similar to Takt’s women.”
“And with each passing second, the domain supplying them with power is expanding. What we saw before coming here was their territory growing.”
“On top of that, once they’ve gathered enough power, it seems they plan to summon something… something they call a hero.”
It’s probably going to be a final boss. Well, whatever kind of final boss these fools summon, I’ll take it down in a single strike.
“Hmph… Originally, the true heroes were meant to dispose of you lot, but it would be a waste to trouble the saviors of the world with such trivial matters.”
“Indeed. To carve out a new world and summon the true hero, offering these impostors as sacrifices is a necessary ritual!”

The New Pope and Trash’s body double each drew their weapons and took a stance. As I glared at them, enemy icons suddenly appeared, and I could sense the presence of monsters. I couldn’t make out their names. Does that mean they’re unidentifiable? However, they seem to have a level and power on par with Takt.

By the way, something has been bothering me. What is that red-and-black pig sitting on the throne in the back doing? It’s just lounging on the throne, acting all high and mighty. It’s like some lazy pig. Though, in reality, it’s entirely different from a mere lazy pig.
“Take this! The combined magic of our devoted followers! ‘Divine Thunder!’ ‘Void Severance!’”

With almost no chanting, Trash’s body double brandished a staff and unleashed magic. At the same time, the Three Heroes Church members appeared, assisting with the magic attack. Father stepped forward, summoning multiple shields at once to protect us.
“Air Strike Shield X! Second Shield X! Air One-Way Shield V! Second One-Way Shield V!”

Was it almost simultaneous? A bolt of lightning, far thicker than “Judgment,” rained down on us, and I felt the oxygen around us being consumed. As Itsuki opened his mouth wordlessly and firmly pulled the trigger, the surrounding air was restored.
“Air Bullet… I thought it was a joke skill, but I never imagined it would be useful here.”
“You had a skill like that?”
“It’s originally a support skill. If used in conjunction with Motoyasu-sama’s fire magic, it should enhance its power.”
“Ah, so it supplies oxygen to make the flames burn hotter?”
“There are various ways to apply it. Elemental arrows… or rather, since it’s a gun now, elemental bullets.”
“Oh… now that’s interesting.”
The New Pope seems to have finished preparing and is about to unleash a glowing purple Brionac. The output is clearly on a whole different level from before.
“Your magic skills rival those of the Wise King of Winsdom… Even if you are fakes, I must commend your strength.”
The Queen and Fiancé responded while chanting their own magic.
“These guys…! How are they this fast!?”

Éclair was fighting off the Three Heroes Church members who were attacking the Queen. They are certainly fast. It’s safe to assume they, like Trash’s body doubles, are also under some kind of divine protection.
“Big Sis! Gaelion and the others will fight too! If we don’t counter that ritual magic with at least chorus magic, Father will be forced into a purely defensive battle!”
“I won’t lose either! Come on, Kou, Sakura! Let’s chant chorus magic together!”
Rival and the Filolial-sama also began chanting magic. Of course, they were simultaneously cutting down the Three Heroes Church members charging at them, as well as demons emerging from the shadows.
“Chorus Magic—‘Blizzard!’”
The Queen and Fiancé unleashed a chorus magic attack at Trash’s body double and his followers.
“I call upon the power of Gaelion, seeking manifestation. Earth, grant me strength!”
Assistant joined in the chant, along with Mole.
